name: Shadow baseline
definition: Pre-registered team-strength model (shrinkage k=8, HFA from prior finals) sides only, flat, paper only
what_would_change_our_mind: Prospective: skill CI low >0 over n>=100 vs market close
demotion_rule: Its CI lower bound falls to <=0 over any rolling 100

name: Home-favourite filter
definition: Shadow baseline restricted to home favourites by model line

name: Totals overlay
definition: Model total vs fair total; bet side of residual once price exists
what_would_change_our_mind: Residual sign stable over n>=100 with CI excluding 0
demotion_rule: CI includes 0 for two consecutive weeks

name: Control: random
definition: Uniform random side per fixture; control only, never ranked for reward

name: Control: favourites only
definition: Always take the model's favourite side; control only

name: Cross-game 2-leg
definition: Two independent fixtures multiplied ONLY after G8-08 joint evidence
what_would_change_our_mind: Validated joint probability + void/push rules available
